observations: A roughly square mass of overlapping colored lines fills most of the canvas against a flat deep-purple background; yellow and gold dominate the upper and outer areas, with teal, magenta, red, and dark blue woven through the interior.

Black lines run in loose loops and open curves across the whole surface, sitting above the colored underlayer and pulling two dark oval clusters near the center into focus as eye-like forms; a lighter triangular wedge below them reads as a nose bridge.

The lower half of the mass is denser and darker—deep teal, brown, and black lines compress toward a horizontal smear of red near the bottom center—while the upper-left quadrant opens into broader yellow and white patches.
reading: Dense looping lines build a face-like form that never fully settles into one reading—the eye-like ovals hold steady while the surrounding mass keeps shifting between hair, shadow, and pure mark-making. The compressed, darker lower half carries a weight the looser yellow upper region does not share, giving the image an uneven pull: something between concentration and unease. The flat purple field keeps all of that contained.
contextAngle: Within the owned nifty-faces subset, this work sits between title neighbors nnxyz nifty faces #21 and nnxyz nifty faces #23 in both title-derived and recorded-creation order. Of the three, #22 is the only one to use a saturated solid background color rather than white or dark brown.

connections.reason: Both works use black looping lines over a multicolor underlayer to locate eye-like forms, but nnxyz nifty faces #21 keeps its structure angular and open on a white ground while #22 packs the same approach into a denser, background-contained mass.

nnxyz nifty faces #23 also wraps a face-like form in layered multicolor lines against a solid dark ground, but its lines are longer and more structural, producing a rounder, more object-like silhouette compared to #22's flatter, more compressed mass.

lookingQuestion: Where exactly do the black lines stop describing the face and become something else—and what is it about that boundary that makes it hard to locate?
ambiguities: The red horizontal smear at the lower center could read as a mouth or as an independent mark; the surrounding line density does not resolve this.

nnxyz nnotb #24 (QmPTd1WuryH9PaFKTsDHV85YyFdk9P76iSG2nGJrQWLTfY) was inspected but shows a clearly different palette and structural approach—flat red field, isolated rounded forms, sparse line work—with no strong formal parallel to #22 beyond both containing face-like forms; not selected as a connection.
